identity.notes: The restaurant-controlled site, FAQ, menu hub, and exact packet-linked Uber Eats storefront agree on 8113 Georgia Avenue in Silver Spring. The current website and vendor give ZIP 20910; 20902 printed in the menu artwork footer is treated as a resolved artwork typo, not a second location.

sources.excerpt: The restaurant-controlled homepage identifies Citizens & Culture at 8113 Georgia Ave, Silver Spring, MD 20910 and publishes its current hours and contact details.
The restaurant-controlled menu hub links the current Brunch image, Dinner image, Happy Hour PDF, and Drinks PDF and repeats the 8113 Georgia Ave, Silver Spring, MD 20910 identity.
Restaurant-issued brunch artwork visually enumerates 17 in-scope food products. Brunch cocktails, mimosas, and the mixed brunch-plus-mimosa experience were excluded as alcoholic.

Restaurant-issued dinner artwork visually enumerates 23 in-scope food products across starters, entrees, salads, handhelds, pasta, and sides, with direct ingredient descriptions but no allergen legend or matrix.
Restaurant-issued happy-hour PDF visually enumerates seven food bites. Drafts, bottled beer, cocktails, and wine are alcohol-only and excluded.

Restaurant-issued drinks PDF contains only alcoholic beer, cocktails, wine, and sparkling wine. It lists no nonalcoholic products, so it is retained as an out-of-scope supporting surface with zero keys.

The exact packet-linked Uber Eats Food Menu identifies Citizens & Culture at 8113 Georgia Avenue and exposes 39 consolidated food products after repeated Featured, Specials, and Late Night presentations are collapsed.
The exact packet-linked Citizens & Culture Online catalog exposes 42 consolidated food products across starters, sandwiches, pasta, entrees, salads, sides, desserts, and extra proteins.

The vendor schedule exposes a third generic Menu slot, but its direct route renders no products. It is retained as non-current support evidence with zero keys rather than treated as a complete publishing surface.

Official-domain, Squarespace CDN, FAQ, sitemap-oriented, and document searches found only the current menu images/PDFs; no allergen matrix, nutrition guide, ingredient guide, or cross-contact statement was found.

Targeted restaurant-name, location, vendor, allergy, allergen, nutrition, and ingredient searches returned the official menus and exact Uber Eats catalog but no attributable comprehensive allergen disclosure.

findings.summary: Citizens & Culture is confirmed at 8113 Georgia Avenue, Silver Spring, MD 20910. The 20902 footer in menu artwork is a resolved typo because the live official site and exact vendor agree on 20910.

The consolidated current union contains 71 food products: 42 appear on restaurant-issued food surfaces and 29 additional products appear on the exact packet-linked vendor catalogs. The official drinks PDF lists no in-scope nonalcoholic products.

Uber Eats repeats products across Featured, category, Specials, Late Night, Food Menu, and Online presentations; punctuation, typo, and service-period variants are consolidated without discarding their source surfaces.

Restaurant-issued and linked-vendor descriptions support direct positive allergen evidence for selected products. No comprehensive disclosure exists, so products lacking a literal positive remain unavailable rather than being treated as allergen-free.

All four required search classes completed without a comprehensive Citizens & Culture allergen matrix, nutrition guide, ingredient guide, or cross-contact disclosure; status is accurately_unavailable.
